name: SAM3Segment3D
label: SAM 3 Segmentation (3D)
description: Segment a 3D volume with Meta's Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) using a text prompt. Each slice along all three axes is segmented independently, the per-axis masks are combined by majority voting, and the result is a 3D instance label map (int32, 0 = background). This operator requires an external conda environment providing sam3 and tomviz-pipeline, and an NVIDIA GPU (CUDA) with at least 8 GB of memory; select the environment in the Execution tab. See the Machine Learning Segmentation documentation page for setup instructions, including model checkpoint download.
